title: Database OOM crash, no restart
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the db as the broken part, memory exhaustion as the problem, and the new API version as the trigger.
root_cause: The newly deployed API version 2.3.2 ran an expensive analytics query that exhausted the PostgreSQL container's memory, triggering the Linux OOM killer (signal 9) and crashing the DB.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced an analytics dashboard query that makes PostgreSQL exceed its 1 GB memory limit; the database was killed (OOM, signal 9) and the container has no restart policy, so it stays down.
check_first: Check the db container's logs and status with `docker ps -a` and `docker logs <db-container-id>`.
